message: そして聖夜

name: Synn
message: 「Hah, hah, hah! Re... Re-Crea's power disappeared?」

name: Bylous
message: 「Th-This is...」

name: Bylous
message: 「I see... I was... by Re-Crea...」

name: Synn
message: 「V-Bylous...?」

name: Bylous
message: 「...Impressive, Demon Lord. It's your win」

name: Synn
message: 「It wasn't just me. It's everyone's victory」

name: Bylous
message: 「Hmph... Not finishing me off is also your group's will... is that it?」

name: Synn
message: 「That's right」

name: Bylous
message: 「I see... You're a soft bunch. Still, I thank you for saving me」

name: Bylous
message: 「If I can be pushed around by that level of power, I suppose I'm still far too inexperienced」

name: Synn
message: 「Now that Re-Crea is gone, you're back to normal. You look good, like a weight's been lifted off you」

name: Bylous
message: 「...Even if it has, it's still not over」

name: Synn
message: 「Wh-What do you mean? What about Re-Crea? It's not over yet!?」

name: Melilot
message: 「No, it has safely come to an end. However, Re-Crea is something that returns again. Even after it passes, it will reappear」

name: Bylous
message: 「You people accomplished your goal and brought it to a close. However, my wish still hasn't been granted. It isn't over」

name: Synn
message: 「Your...?」

name: Bylous
message: 「A match with the Demon Lord」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't tell me that means... fighting me again--」

name: Bylous
message: 「Yeah, a rematch. One-on-one this time... Definitely, in the near future」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Hey, hold on! Jeez, why are people from the Demon World like this」

name: Misa
message: 「Mmmmm...」

name: Synn
message: 「Say something to him too, Misa」

name: Misa
message: 「Bring it on, Bylous! I'll take you on as many times as it takes. It's a match with Sakura-kun!」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Misa?!」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm the one who's going to beat you. So there's no way you can lose to anyone else, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah... I'm gonna win. Definitely.」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes! That's the spirit!」

name: Bylous
message: 「The aftermath of Re-Crea still lingers... Train yourself before our next encounter.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, got it.」

name: Bylous
message: 「Farewell, then.」

name: Azel
message: 「Wait!」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel?!」

name: Bylous
message: 「Have you come to mock me, Vessel of the Great Dream?」

name: Azel
message: 「Take this.」

name: Bylous
message: 「...What is that?」

name: Azel
message: 「This is something from the Human World called tonjiru. You should eat some before you go.」

name: Bylous
message: 「Haha, very well! Let's eat!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... That was the greatest Re-Crea in history!!」
The Holy Night Festival, which began after every crisis had been settled, had reached the peak of its excitement.
Demons and angels they had met along the way, along with humans dressed in costumes, were gathered in a circle enjoying themselves.
With the dance party wrapping up in great success, Misa's turn was finally coming up.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Miss Vice President sure is taking her time~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Things were chaotic right up until the end, so it can't be helped.」

name: Ria
message: 「This is the moment everyone gathers together all at once, so she can't afford to mess up. You can do it, Misa-chan!」

name: Synn
message: 「Look, Azel. For this part, you go like this--hmm-hmm-hmmm♪」

name: Azel
message: 「You're off-key」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that right--」

name: Sally
message: 「Pres is tone-deaf!」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Ode, sing. Bwoeh~~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「No, no, no~. Here, you sing it like this~♪」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Waaah! You're so good, Sacchin-san」

name: Shio
message: 「Mmm... I too must undergo training in kara-oh-ke!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Please leave the bass part to this humble Riesling Tooyama」

name: Arden
message: 「I'm dedicating my love song to Pasta-chan!!」

name: Pasta
message: 「I don't wanna hear it, nyaaa!!」

name: Helena
message: 「Heehee... Could you ever imagine angels, humans, and even Demons singing in a chorus together?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Sakura-kun... No, the Crusaders managed to unite the Three Realms even without Re-Crea, didn't they」

name: Helena
message: 「What do you say, Bylous? Care to join them?」

name: Melilot
message: 「There is no way this man would ever do such a thing」

name: Bylous
message: 「Same goes for you」

name: Helena
message: 「Bzzzt, wrong answer. After all, I trained Melilot thoroughly myself♪」

name: Melilot
message: 「Eh」

name: Helena
message: 「Come on, let's go!」
The volume of the dance music slowly fades down.
The extravagant lighting dims in the exact same way.
Next up is Misa's big moment in the spotlight.
The grand chorus with her taking the lead is about to begin.

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh」

name: Misa
message: 「You're coming too!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaat!?」

name: Misa
message: 「You're the one who said it, aren't you? That we're going to have a sparkling school life」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah, of course」

name: Misa
message: 「So let's do it together... okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「...Yeah! Definitely」

name: Misa
message: 「Because you're here, I can shine」

name: Synn
message: 「And it's because you've been there for me, Misa」

name: Misa
message: 「So, I'm sure--」

name: Synn
message: 「From now on, forever--」

name: Synn & Misa
message: 「May we keep sparkling brightly--!!」
